briefdescription.para: Return a unique monotonic session identifier.

detaileddescription.para: The identifier can be used to check whether or not a session is alive. 0 means there is no session (e.g. a procedure is running in a detached fiber).

briefdescription.para: Return the id of currently executed request.

detaileddescription.para: Many requests share the same session so this is only valid at session start. 0 for non-iproto sessions.
Note: user id (effective_user()->uid) may be different in a setuid function.
Note: effective user id may be different in a setuid function.
Note: effective user name may be different in a setuid function or in box.session.su() used in sudo mode.
